## 🚀 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature.

## 💡 Problem or Opportunity
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe. (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...")

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented, how it should look or behave, and API considerations.

## 🎨 Mockups / UI Considerations
If applicable, describe UI/UX mockups, animations, or screenshots.

## 🤝 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📌 Additional Context
Add any other context, references or links to similar implementations here.
